test_title: PYST 42: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Identify the MISSPELT word in the following sentence.**

As they only require minimal supervision and support, naturally bright learners are largely unaffected by classroom dinamics.
solution: The correct answer is **"dinamics."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **"dynamics"**, no**t "dinamics".** • The word **"dynamics"** refers to the forces or properties that stimulate growth or change within a system or process. (एक विशिष्‍ट स्थिति में व्‍यक्तियों या वस्‍तुओं के परस्‍पर व्‍यवहार का तरीक़ा) • **Example**: *This software is used for modelling atmospheric **dynamics**__.* • The misspelling of the word in the sentence does not affect the overall meaning of the sentence. The correct answer is **Option 3.** **Correct sentence**: *As they only require minimal supervision and support, naturally bright learners are largely unaffected by classroom __**dynamics**__.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (minimal)** is spelled correctly and means "the least possible amount or degree." (मात्रा, आकार या स्‍तर में बहुत कम; यथासंभव न्‍यूनतम) • **Option 2 (supervision)** is spelled correctly and refers to the act of overseeing or managing a person or group. (निरीक्षण, निगरानी, पर्यवेक्षण) • **Option 4 (unaffected)** is spelled correctly and means "not influenced or changed by something." ((किसी से) अप्रभावित) 3c:Ta2f, The correct answer is **"dinamics."**
